module purpose: neorv32_cpu_cp_muldiv decodes arithmetic control information from ctrl_i, uses rs1_i and rs2_i to execute multiply or divide/remainder operations, sequences the selected engine until completion, and drives the result on res_o with a completion indication on valid_o.

use-case flows.value: accepted arithmetic co-processor command decode, signedness decode, and routing to the multiply or divide start signal
multiplication product computation and selection of low or high product bits for res_o
division/remainder working-state update and final signed quotient or remainder generation when DIVISION_EN is enabled
operation completion indication and result-enable assertion when the sequence reaches done
control, multiplier, and divider state cleared when rstn_i = '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Decoded arithmetic operation mode — whether ctrl_i requests a supported operation, which engine starts, and whether operands are treated as signed
conceptual assets.reasoning: The start flow first qualifies a request in valid_cmd from ctrl_i fields at lines 97-99, then derives operand sign handling at lines 148-151, and finally raises mul.start or div.start at lines 154-155; line 121-124 uses the same decode to choose the fast-multiply done path or the busy path. Integrity is established because the multiply/divide operate flows depend on accepting only the intended command, starting the correct engine, and interpreting operands with the correct signedness. Availability is also established conditionally because a decoded request can leave S_IDLE and produce the matching start signal (lines 120-125, 154-155).

conceptual assets.concept: Operation sequencing and completion state — idle/busy/done progress, remaining iteration count, and the done/output-enable indication
conceptual assets.reasoning: The control flow stores and updates the operation progress state. Reset forces ctrl.state, ctrl.cnt, and ctrl.out_en to known values at lines 106-109. During operation, ctrl.cnt is reloaded and decremented (lines 113, 130), ctrl.state moves to done when the count expires or ctrl_i.cpu_trap is asserted (lines 131-132), ctrl.out_en is asserted in the done branch (line 137), and valid_o is driven from ctrl.state = S_DONE (line 145). Integrity is established because these values gate iterative updates of mul.prod and div.quotient/div.remainder and determine when completion and result presentation occur; corrupting them changes the implemented step count, termination condition, or done signaling. Availability is conditionally established because, after a started operation and absent reset, the sequence can progress to done under the RTL-visible conditions.

conceptual assets.concept: Multiplication working/result state — the product accumulation and the low or high multiply result driven on res_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: The multiplication flow stores and delivers product data. With FAST_MUL_EN, mul.start captures sign-adjusted operands from rs1_i and rs2_i into mul.dsp_x and mul.dsp_y (lines 170-172), computes mul.dsp_z at line 178, and registers mul.prod at line 184. Without FAST_MUL_EN, the same concept is realized by initializing and shifting mul.prod at lines 210-215 using mul.add and mul.p_sext at lines 223-235. res_o then takes the low or high half of mul.prod at lines 325-327 when ctrl.out_en = '1' (line 322). Integrity is established because the multiply operate flow depends on this stored product state and the selected half being exact; availability is established conditionally when a multiply command is accepted and the control state enables the output.

conceptual assets.concept: Division/remainder working/result state — normalized divisor, iterative quotient/remainder, sign-correction state, and the final result driven on res_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: When DIVISION_EN is enabled, div.start initializes div.quotient from rs1_i or its magnitude (lines 263-266), div.rs2_abs from rs2_i or its magnitude (lines 269-272), div.sign_mod from operand signs and the selected quotient/remainder behavior (lines 275-280), and clears div.remainder (line 283). In the busy/done states, div.quotient and div.remainder are updated from div.sub (lines 284-290, 296), div.res_u selects quotient or remainder (line 299), and div.res applies sign correction (line 300). res_o copies div.res at line 329 when ctrl.out_en = '1' (line 322). Integrity is established because the divide/remainder operate flow is defined by these stored values and the sign-correction decision; availability is established conditionally when DIVISION_EN and the control sequence reaches the output state. When DIVISION_EN is false, lines 307-313 tie the divider state low and line 99 blocks this flow.
